title: Flat degree-zero opcycles from universal degree-minus-one vanishing on an affine scheme
statement: Let S be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] and C a cochain complex of O_S-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Assume every C^n is quasi-coherent and flat over the identity S -> S [def-pc-morphism-conventions]. If for every scheme map g:S′ -> S the degree -1 homology of the termwise pullback g*C is zero [def-pc-base-change], then C.opcycles 0 = coker(d^(-1):C^(-1) -> C^0) is flat over the identity S -> S. No boundedness or finite-presentation hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tags 0653 (tensor exactness implies flat opcycles) and 01IB (affine quasi-coherent equivalence); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0653 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01IB

proof.text: Define F to be evaluation on the top open and P=F(C). Evaluate each term’s IsFlatOver(identity) at V=U=S. Identify the identity appLE ring map with the identity, so the induced scalar action equals the native global-section action. This gives Module.Flat A (P.X n) for every n.
Apply affine_universal_tensor_exact in degree -1 to each A-module N. Its tensor complex is ExactAt (0-1).
Apply Module.Flat.opcycles_of_exactAt to P at zero, using the term flatness and tensor exactness just obtained.
Apply affine_opcycles_flat_from_sections at zero using quasi-coherence of C^(-1) and C^0 and the module opcycles flatness. This gives exactly the unchanged IsFlatOver(identity) conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0653 and 01IB; original four-step square-zero argument made into Lean by H1. Steps 1--2 and 4 are separated as two strictly partial comparison statements.

mathlib_searches.query: Universal vanishing after base change of a quasi coherent affine complex implies flat opcycles
For a quasi coherent complex on an affine scheme universally zero negative homology implies flat degree zero opcycles
mathlib_searches.results: AlgebraicGeometry.flat_iff and Flat.flat_appLE; derived cohomology vanishing lemmas; no universal-opcycles statement
ShortComplex.opcyclesIsoCokernel and opcycles functors; no affine universal exactness criterion

Sheaf.Algebra.Homology.FlatOpcyclesTorCriterion gives the module criterion; source categorical flat_opcycles_of_exactAt gives tensor-flatness from sheaf tensor tests. Neither translates scheme base-change tests into these tensor tests.

from.place: Coherence unit part (a): Flat degree-zero opcycles from universal degree-minus-one vanishing on an affine scheme

lean.statement:
theorem affine_opcycles_flat_of_universally_exact (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : IsAffine S)
    (C : CochainComplex S.Modules ℤ)
    (hflat : ∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 S))
    (hqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hexact : ∀ {S' : Scheme.{u}} (g : S' ⟶ S),
      IsZero ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj C).homology (-1))) :
    (C.opcycles 0).IsFlatOver (𝟙 S)
